newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Asia Terminals Ltd to set HK$1.75 bln loan.
newsitem.headline: HK's Asia Terminals Ltd to set HK$1.75 bln loan.

text.p: Asia Terminals Ltd has mandated ABN Amro Bank and Societe Generale Asia as coordinating arrangers for a HK$1.75 billion loan, the banks said Friday.
The facility has a final maturity of seven years.
Repayment is in 27 semi-equal annual installments commencing six months after the agreement date.
It pays an interest margin of 60 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
Management fees are 26 basis points for arrangers committing HK$200 million.
The deal is secured by a mortgage over building, a floating charge over the borrower's assets, assignment of insurances, assignment of income and a charge of operating and retention account.

Financial covenants of the loan state that the company's net worth must be at least HK$700 million, that it must maintain debt service coverage of 1.15 times and that its dividend payout must not exceed 50 percent of net profit.
Hong Kong law is the governing law.
An arranger group is being formed. The deadline for replies is March 26, 1997.
Asia Terminals Ltd is largely held by New World Infrastructure.
